E0.description: Baseline: TF-IDF + LinearSVC intent, rule/dictionary slots, TF-IDF retrieval per ingredient, independent cheapest-option selection, post-hoc diet and budget filtering.

E1.description: E0 with the transformer parser (DistilBERT, 3 seeds). Retrieval and selection as E0. Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

E2.description: E1 with MiniLM retrieval as frozen in Phase 7 (product text display_name_ingredient, 40 candidates). Independent selection with post-hoc filtering. Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

E3.description: E2 with constrained selection (CP-SAT, configs/solver.json) without association-aware terms (history and pair weights 0). Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

E4.description: E3 with association-aware scoring: the history and pair terms at the frozen Phase 9 weights (configs/solver.json). Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

A1.description: Ablation: E4 with the E0 baseline parser. Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

A2.description: Ablation: E4 with TF-IDF retrieval (same product text and candidate count, so only the retrieval method changes). Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

A3.description: Ablation: E4 with association (pair) weight 0; the history term stays. Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.

A4.description: Ablation: E4 with independent selection and post-hoc filtering. The independent selector ignores the history and pair terms, so this configuration coincides with E2 by construction; it is run separately as a check. Phase 11 run; frozen before any test data was read.
